description: Swap generic plant shapes for species once the designer has signed off the layout: each species stands in its shapes' place at its own catalog size — one plant for a tree, shrub or clump; a row half its spread apart along a hedge; plants at their density over a ground-cover mat (which can also take a `mix` of species, neighbours differing) or a drift. The whole call is one undo step. A species far from its shape's size, or one species planting over about a tenth of the plants, holds the whole call back (`needsAcknowledgement`: nothing is swapped): tell the designer, then call again with `acknowledged: true`. `differs` says where a species' size is outside its shape's. Show the design before and after and ask the designer to approve; if they don't, `undo` brings the shapes back.

acknowledged.description: The designer has been told about the species far off their shapes' size, or planting over a tenth of the garden, and agreed (see needsAcknowledgement)

ids.description: Shapes taking this species (an entry of suggest_species)

mix.description: Ground cover only: several species mixed over the mat, instead of productId

name: swap_shapes
